description: This file defines a set of asynchronous command functions for a shipping router within an economy-related module. It uses a Router object to register multiple commands that retrieve shipping and port data via external providers, returning data objects based on queries.

methods.name: OBBject port_info( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Retrieves metadata and statistics for all ports from a specified provider.

methods.name: OBBject port_volume( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Retrieves daily port call data and trading volumes for ports around the world.

methods.name: OBBject chokepoint_info( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Retrieves metadata and statistics for maritime chokepoint locations.

methods.name: OBBject chokepoint_volume( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Retrieves data on transit trade volumes and shipping lane chokepoints.
